scope: Isolated Apple M5 component experiments. Offline, licensed public files only. No production microphone, install or archive. Neither alternative is in the shipping worker.

scalar_groups.protocol: One testing helper, current audio only, upstream greedy vs chains of four unchanged scalar [1,1] greedy GPU steps, host synchronizes the chain; EOS always uses the original algorithm. Each arm starts a fresh helper. Wall time covers inferences and pipe delivery after the ready signal. Process CPU includes startup and exit.
scalar_groups.decision: Rejected; 31 of 31 outputs matched token for token but both clips took longer with grouped synchronization.

magnitude_cache.protocol: Four alternating-order, CPU-only comparisons across the 73 actual packet-prefix lengths from the 442 continuous cost replay. Both paths use the pinned Accelerate production Swift STFT/mel math up to the Float32 array passed into MLX. Each append-only segment caches only full FFT magnitude rows with no reflected right input (200-sample context). Subsequent filterbank, full maximum/clamp and normalization always recomputed. CPU benchmark reuses prefixes of the same verified continuous WAV for both groups; this is not a full VAD/model run.
magnitude_cache.decision: Rejected. Cumulative median CPU improvement of 0.0322 s per 73 previews versus 15.69 s total baseline helper CPU, roughly 0.2%, for up to 3,033,628 bytes of cached magnitudes.
